critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Toaster is duplicated (Login has its own + Layout likely too). Not blocking, but consider hoisting Toaster to App.js so it renders once for all routes.
Login.jsx catch block silently swallows error object; formatApiError result is toasted which is good, but consider adding console.error for debugging.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login bug fully fixed. Login.jsx uses useNavigate+navigate('/',{replace:true}) after successful login; Toaster now present on Login and Setup pages so wrong-password error toast is visible. Backend unchanged, data intact.
rca of the issue: Root cause: When user visits /login directly and successfully logs in, React Router (App.js line 54 `<Route path='/login' element={<Login/>} />`) continued matching /login route, so Login component stayed mounted even though AuthContext.user was populated. Fix: navigate('/', {replace:true}) after login success → URL switches to /, which is handled by Guarded, which now renders Dashboard because user is present. Additionally, Toaster was only rendered inside authenticated Layout, so on the public Login/Setup pages error toasts had no host container and appeared silent. Fix: added <Toaster /> to Login.jsx and Setup.jsx.
